title: Hailuo Light Studio referenced its Relight tool
summary: On 2026-03-20, the Hailuo Light Studio development line included a link to its Relight tool page. The sealed evidence establishes the dated tool reference, but not whether it represented a launch, an update, or routine promotion. This history event therefore records the reference without making further capability or availability claims.
